prompt: Tọa độ véc-tơ AB→ trong hình vẽ sau là
solution: Dựa vào hình vẽ ta có <math display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><mi>A</mi><mrow><mo stretchy="true" form="prefix">(</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>;</mo><mn>4</mn><mo stretchy="true" form="postfix">)</mo></mrow></mrow></semantics></math> và <math display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><mi>B</mi><mrow><mo stretchy="true" form="prefix">(</mo><mn>4</mn><mo>;</mo><mn>2</mn><mo stretchy="true" form="postfix">)</mo></mrow></mrow></semantics></math> nên <math display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><mover><mrow><mi>A</mi><mi>B</mi></mrow><mo accent="true">→</mo></mover><mo>=</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="true" form="prefix">(</mo><mn>3</mn><mo>;</mo><mo>−</mo><mn>2</mn><mo stretchy="true" form="postfix">)</mo></mrow></mrow></semantics></math>.
